verdict.rationale: iTerm2 documents Session Restoration where shells run in long-lived server processes and reconnect exactly where left off after a crash or restart, plus tmux -CC integration that keeps sessions alive independent of the app and shell integration that tracks working directory across sessions. This directly covers windows/tabs/panes and working directory restoration after crash/restart. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of restoration fidelity across all edge cases (e.g., complex window arrangements) and any community corroboration specifically of restart/crash recovery reliability.
